title: 金克丝·蓝辫高架
description: 蓝色长双辫金克丝穿完整深色工装，静立宽阔高架走道，标志装备安全背负不瞄准，强光划出清楚剪影。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Jinx is an adult woman with extremely long bright-blue twin braids, magenta eyes, sharp expressive brows, and a confident irreverent face. Preserve her slender natural adult comic proportions while fully clothing her in a high-neck long-sleeved dark work jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. A recognizable shark-shaped fantasy launcher remains securely strapped behind her with its mouth closed and no active lights or firing.
art_direction.scene: She pauses on a broad secure elevated walkway, one hand resting on the plain railing and the other relaxed beside her leg, looking across an immense simplified industrial skyline. Both boots stay planted; the long braids form clear separate diagonals. Strong warm side light and deep blue coarse wax facets emphasize resolve, without destruction, smoke, aiming, or any running action.
art_direction.palette: electric blue hair, charcoal, muted magenta, copper light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
